notes.subject: יבצר
notes.rationale: בצר from 'cut off/gather grapes': KJV 'cut off' vs YLT 'gather' vs JPS 'minisheth' — the verb's picture is debated.

notes.subject: fiɲɛ
notes.rationale: רוח is wind/breath/spirit; Bambara fiɲɛ covers wind and spirit.

notes.subject: ⟨a yɛrɛ bɛ⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew has no pronoun; added to mark who is fearful to the kings.

notes.subject: to the kings of the earth
notes.rationale: Indirect address naming Yawe's awe before earthly kings.

translation: A bɛ negidibaw ka fiɲɛ bɔ ⟨a yɛrɛ bɛ⟩ siranbaliya dɔ ye dugukolo masakɛw ye.
